title: Tagsets glyph metadata
description: One per glyph. A glyph with `text` is composed from the stroke alphabet; a drawn `<name>.svg` beside it is the fixed (24x24) variant.

label.description: Human name, used for titles and search: "MIT License".

code.description: Canonical code in the tagset's standard: "MIT", "en", "NOUN".

aliases.description: Other codes that resolve to this glyph (SPDX ids, ISO 639-2 codes, Penn Treebank tags).

text.description: Characters to set on one line in the stroke alphabet. The hug variant always shows it; the fixed variant shows it when it fits the square.

short.description: Fixed-variant text for when `text` is too wide for the square: "AP2" for "APACHE2". Without one (and without a drawn SVG), a glyph that does not fit is hug-only.

frame.description: What the content sits in. Defaults to the tagset frame, else none. A drawn SVG must start with this frame.

credit.description: Where a drawn glyph geometry comes from, with its license.
